File it as a claim (upgrade reduction-passage-exact to status: proved, or file reduction-audit-prefix-determinism-proved), anchored in research/notes/reduction-passage-exact.md, which already states the recurrence δ_k(q_n) = |δ_{k-1}(q_n) − δ_{k-1}(q_{n-1})| that makes eps_k = δ_{k-1}(q_{n-1}) a stored-prefix entry. This converts the audit from evidence into an argument — the pattern that is working for this run after descent_lemma.lean.
